prompt: Research and value Materialise across additive software, services, and medical workflows.

inputs.causal_hypothesis: AI-assisted additive adoption may expand demand for workflow software and production services, although medical economics may dominate and generic AI tools may disrupt parts of the software stack.
inputs.focused_questions: Separate software, manufacturing, and medical segments; test recurring software quality, integration and switching costs, service utilization, medical dominance, margins, control weaknesses, liquidity, balance sheet, ADS/listing structure, scenarios, rating, and invalidation.
